street.plate: School photo 8 directly shows six glazed lights over the three-character sign and four horizontal red masonry courses immediately below. Their concealed backs are estimated.
street.initial_interpretation: The fixed 30-probe table assigned (106,160) to the floor fascia. The source pixel and its neighbours instead fall on a grey band above the fascia. The originally selected probe is retained in the test, with its mismatch. The portal centre looks dark in the photograph; the oblique ray can strike a masonry return even though a person can look through on-axis. The fixed upper-eave probe (112,93) is sky on the source photo. The visible eave begins six image pixels lower at (112,99). The score retains the original test position and expectation.

court.ref: School photo 1. A ray at the front of the lower colonnade places the red capital sample (60,77) at 2.54 m above the model datum; the first mesh stopped its red stack at 2.44 m. The transverse shelf sample (528,129) meets the perpendicular return near 3.75 m. Both were independently read again.

roof.court_aerial: Three red-edged dark triangles are visible beneath the crowns of the short transverse hipped roofs. A parked tree screens most of the fourth front end. The fourth follows the bounded form of its visible two ridges.
roof.street_silhouette: The initial second cross hip appeared above the unobscured roof edge in the ground photograph. Its eave vertices stay tied to the long facade; the short vent apex is set behind the front eave and below the long roof ridge. The roof pitch and vent depth are inferred jointly from the two perspectives.
